summary: Volkswagen AG is ADVERSE due to a criminal guilty plea on 2017-01-11 (felony conspiracy, $4.3 billion in fines) and major civil judgments/sanctions, including $25 billion extracted by U.S. authorities on 2018-02-06 and total emissions‑related fines exceeding US$30 billion.

findings.statement: The full legal name of Volkswagen AG is Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft.
Volkswagen AG's headquarters is located in Wolfsburg, Germany.
As of 2026-10-01, the Chief Executive Officer of Volkswagen AG is Oliver Blume, appointed effective 1 January 2026.
Volkswagen AG pleaded guilty to criminal felonies related to the diesel emissions scandal on 11 January 2017 and agreed to pay $4.3 billion in criminal and civil fines.
U.S. authorities extracted $25 billion in fines, penalties, civil damages and restitution from Volkswagen for the diesel emissions scandal, as reported on 6 February 2018.
Volkswagen AG has been fined over US$30 billion for using defeat devices to evade emissions regulations.
